Initial release of hotbee-bilibili-collect.

- Enables parsing and collection of Bilibili video data using a supplied public URL from bilibili.com or b23.tv.
- Requires explicit user confirmation before each live data call, warning of HotBee quota consumption.
- Uses only the HOTBEE_API_KEY from the local environment; sensitive tokens and signed parameters are never exposed.
- Does not bypass access controls or platform restrictions.
- Operates via the provided CLI command and refers to verified API documentation.
